svg.font-family: Lato, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, 'Liberation Sans', sans-serif

text.font-family: 'Playfair Display', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', 'Liberation Serif', serif
text.tspan: Child mortality vs. share in extreme poverty 2024
Child mortality is the share of children who die before reaching their fifth birthday, versus the share of the
population living below the International Poverty Line of $3 per day.

tspan.tspan: United Nations Inter-agency Group for Child Mortality Estimation (2025); World Bank Poverty and Inequality Platform (2026)
Poverty data is measured in international-$ at 2021 prices to account for inflation and differences in living costs between countries.

text.tspan: Depending on the country and year, it relates to income (measured after taxes and benefits) or to consumption, per capita. Where data for
2024 is unavailable, the value from the closest year between 2019 and 2026 is shown instead.
